rows.answer: You must submit a standard reimbursement claim within 30 days of discharge [1][2]. However, for group corporate plans, the submission window is 60 days from discharge [5]. (An archived 2024 timeline previously specified 15 days from discharge [3].)
The room rent limit on the Silver plan is 2% of the sum insured per day [3][4].
No, maternity is not covered on the Bronze plan at any sum insured [1][2].

For standard retail, Top-Up, Super Top-Up, and Hospital Cash Benefit plans, the waiting period for pre-existing diseases is 36 months [5][7][9][10]. Under the Aurora Senior Care plan for ages 60 and above, the waiting period is reduced to 24 months [5].
The grace period for an annual policy is 30 days from the renewal due date [1][5].
Aurora's network covers 11,400 hospitals across 780 towns as of 1 April 2026 [1].

On the Gold plan, the no-claim bonus is 25% of the base sum insured for each claim-free year, accumulating up to a maximum of 100% [1][5]. A claim does not reduce the accumulated bonus; it only stops accumulation for that specific year [1].
No, you cannot claim for IVF treatment, as it is listed under permanent exclusions [1].
Under the Aurora Gold plan, the sub-limit for cataract surgery is ₹75,000 per eye [1].

If you are not satisfied with the Stage 1 outcome from customer service, you can escalate the issue to Aurora's Grievance Redressal Officer (GRO) [2]. If Aurora's final response is still unsatisfactory or if they have not responded within 30 days of your original complaint, you may approach the Insurance Ombudsman for your region [1].

All plans provide road ambulance cover of ₹5,000 per hospitalisation [1][6][9]. Additionally, the Aurora Gold plan includes air ambulance cover of up to ₹2,50,000 per policy year within India, subject to prior authorisation [5].

Yes, in-patient treatment for mental illness is covered on the same terms as physical illness as required by the Mental Healthcare Act 2017 [1]. The standard 30-day initial waiting period applies, but no separate waiting period does [1].

The free-look period is the window in which a new policy can be returned for a refund [3]. A new policyholder may cancel within 15 days of receiving the policy document, or 30 days if the policy was sold through distance marketing [1][2]. The refund is calculated as the premium paid minus proportionate risk premium for the period of cover, medical examination costs, and stamp duty [2].
You earn 150 wellness points per year for completing an annual health check-up [1].

A day-care procedure is a procedure that requires less than 24 hours of hospitalisation because of technological advances, making it payable despite the general 24-hour admission requirement [3]. Out-patient treatment is not considered a day-care procedure [3].
For a cashless emergency admission, the hospital must notify Aurora within 24 hours of admission [1][5].
No, Aurora administers its own claims and does not use a Third Party Administrator (TPA) [1].
To qualify as a hospital under the policy, a facility must have at least 10 in-patient beds in towns with a population below 10 lakh, or at least 15 in-patient beds elsewhere [1].

No, not everything will be paid [1][8]. Under the Silver plan with a ₹5,00,000 sum insured, the room-rent limit is 2% (₹10,000 per day), meaning occupying a room at ₹15,000 per day results in an eligibility ratio of 0.667 (10,000 ÷ 15,000) [1]. Consequently, proportionate deductions will apply to all expenses tied to the room category, leaving you with out-of-pocket costs, even though pharmacy and consumables are not proportionately reduced [5][8].

Waiting periods already served with a previous insurer will carry over only up to the sum insured of your previous policy, including its accrued no-claim bonus [1][2]. Any increase or excess in the sum insured will be subject to fresh waiting periods on the incremental amount [1][2].

To continue insurance coverage for your newborn beyond the initial 90 days, you must inform Aurora and add the baby to your policy as a dependent within 90 days of birth [1]. Doing so within this 90-day window guarantees addition without medical underwriting [1]. 

If you are filing a reimbursement claim for the delivery or hospitalisation, the main claim must be submitted within 30 days of discharge, and any post-hospitalisation bills within 15 days of the end of the post-hospitalisation window [3][8].

Under the Aurora Silver plan, making a claim reduces your accumulated no-claim bonus by 10 percentage points rather than resetting it to zero [1].
Under the Gold plan, the limit for a Caesarean section is ₹1,00,000 per delivery [1]. If the hospital bills ₹1,60,000, your out-of-pocket cost would be ₹60,000 [1].

No, knee replacement is not covered immediately unless it is required following an accident, for which coverage applies from day one [1][5]. Otherwise, knee joint replacement has a 24-month waiting period [1][5].

Total discounts are capped at 30% of the base premium [1]. However, the wellness discount (up to 15% at renewal) is applied last, after the cap, and is the only discount that may exceed this limit [1][3][5].

Cashless access is not available at an excluded provider [2][3]. You can only claim through reimbursement, which requires pre-approval, and the claim is payable only if the admission was a genuine emergency where no alternative facility was reachable [1][3].

For standard reimbursement claims, you have 45 days from the date of the query to respond, after which Aurora closes the claim [2][5]. For Aurora Motor Insurance claims, the deadline to respond to a query is 30 days from the date of the query [4]. (Under archived 2024 claim rules, the deadline was 30 days [6]).

For a planned cashless admission, notification or pre-authorisation must be submitted at least 72 hours before admission [2][3]. However, an archived 2024 timeline document lists the deadline as 48 hours before admission [1].

Aurora settles or rejects a complete reimbursement claim within 15 working days of receiving the last required document [1][2]. If a query is raised, the timeline restarts once the queried document is provided [1]. For motor insurance claims, settlement or rejection takes 30 days from the surveyor report [8].

Aurora Gold has nil co-payment across all ages [1]. Aurora Silver has no co-payment for insured members below the age of 60 [2]. Additionally, two of the Aurora Group Health corporate plan variants feature nil co-payment [6].

Across the four plans, pre-hospitalisation cover is 30 days, 45 days, 60 days, and 90 days, respectively [1]. The corresponding post-hospitalisation cover across the four plans is 60 days, 90 days, 120 days, and 180 days [1].

You can choose either the Gold or Platinum plan, as both allow coverage for dependent parents-in-law [1]. Both plans remove room-rent sub-limits, with Gold covering any single private room and Platinum offering no room-rent limit except for suites [3][6][8].
Dental treatment and oral surgery are permanently excluded unless necessitated by an accidental injury requiring hospitalisation [2][3]. Out-patient dental work is also not covered by any plan [1].

You will lose accumulated benefits, such as waiting period continuity and accumulated no-claim bonuses, if you do not pay before the grace period expires [2][3]. The grace period is 30 days from the renewal due date for annual policies and 15 days for policies paid in instalments [1][5]. Once the grace period expires, the policy is treated as fresh, waiting periods restart, accumulated no-claim bonus is lost, and fresh underwriting applies [2].

Completing a quit-tobacco programme earns 200 wellness points per year [2]. These points convert to a renewal-premium discount at a rate of 1,000 points for a 5% discount, capped at 15% [3].
For Aurora Silver (Product UIN: AUR-HI-SIL-2026), the sum insured options are ₹5,00,000 (₹5L) or ₹10,00,000 (₹10L) [2][7][8]. These options are available on an individual or family-floater basis [8].
No, it is not covered [1]. Refractive error correction is permanently excluded where the error is less than 7.5 dioptres [1].
